in_marathi.name: Banupriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Daughter of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banupriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Banupriya' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Banu' meaning 'daughter' and 'Priya' meaning 'beloved'. This name signifies that the beloved one is a daughter of the gods, blessed and protected by the divine.
